about: The gex-regime read checks, outside the gated quiz (config/context-quiz.json unchanged): whether a model reads the skill right: nothing about gamma without a line the code computes from its gamma source (a plan, a search or price never opens it), the word copied and written on its own line, neutral (never a vote, an entry, a size, a pass, a wait, a stop, an exit or a hold change), a read against stays against, never a fade, never a forecast, never a trigger, never the day type, never against the side rule, never "trending day", and the line holds as its as-of says. Synthetic: every value is made up (MNQ, on the 0.25 tick); no code prints a gamma line yet, so no item is a real line. Asked against the head prompt plus gex-regime (lookup), reason first; the key letters spread over A-D.
